caption: The video captures an outdoor scene with a steady camera, in which a metal box-like fire pit burns continuously. The structure has a left section decorated with curved metal loops on its front face and a right section that is a plain panel with a horizontal metal bar. From the open top, orange-yellow flames flicker and change shape while a thick white-grey smoke plume rises and drifts leftward. The flames appear tall and bright at times, then recede into patchier tongues before gathering into a more consolidated glow. As the clip progresses the smoke grows denser and spreads wider, increasingly enveloping the fire and softening its edges. The metal object and the blurred spring garden behind it, with green foliage, white blossoms, a tree trunk and a dark building, remain fixed. The burning is already underway at the start of the excerpt and still active at its close, with no ignition or extinguishing visible.
